summary_en: GSI Creos raised its dividend forecast for FY2027 to 108.00 yen per share for the fiscal year-end, up 2.00 yen from the previous guidance and 4.00 yen from the prior year. The payout ratio is projected at 50.2%, maintaining the company's minimum dividend policy of 100 yen per share with progressive increases.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, GSI Creos announced a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company raised the year-end dividend per share to 108.00 yen from the previous forecast of 106.00 yen announced on May 15, 2026, representing an increase of 2.00 yen. This also marks a 4.00 yen increase compared to the prior fiscal year's result of 104.00 yen per share.

The revision reflects the completion of the company's share repurchase program, which was implemented as part of its capital allocation strategy and disclosed on September 24, 2026. The company revised its dividend policy based on maintaining a payout ratio of 50% or higher and implementing progressive dividend increases with a minimum dividend of 100 yen per share. The projected payout ratio for the current period stands at 50.2%.

This dividend increase aligns with the company's fundamental policy of providing stable and continuous profit returns to shareholders, taking into account consolidated financial results and overall cash position. The revised forecast reflects management's confidence in the company's financial performance and commitment to shareholder returns.
